method: Search-index factual paraphrases; inaccessible source pages are not bypassed and no complete source article is archived. Native art remains unverified1to1.

facts.summary: Tekken3 first palette has green skin, dark markings, wings and one gold thigh accessory. The right arm is one large viper; multiple smaller snakes belong to Tag2. Left arm has claws. No gold body armour is selected.
Living allied Ophelia has brown shoulder-length hair, green eyes, black T-shirt/jeans, spiked wrist and belt accessories and paired blades; Drowned Ophelia is a separate form.
Indexed official Prima cast description presents Lars as long-blond-haired, muscular and shirtless with an arm tattoo. His sword is Battle Cry. Selected rallying action keeps it sheathed.
Lars leads Ironheade and carries the Battle Cry sword; command support is a declared gameplay relay, not inability to fight or an invented musical weapon.
This specific N64 game gives Ebisumaru a wooden paddle, upgraded to a decorative paddle. Generic series mallets do not identify his selected game equipment.
The N64 GreatAdventure costume retains the long green hair and purple trousers-era shinobi outfit; later skirt redesigns belong to other games.

Kiya final MediEvil2 appearance uses blue skin, long black hair, green eyes, cloth wrappings, brown boots, red navel gem and gold headpiece/necklace. She helps through knowledge and guidance, without an invented sword.
Selected Kiwami appearance differs from Yakuza0: short side-parted undercut, goatee and a left eyepatch with the yellow snakeskin outfit. The ponytail belongs to Yakuza0. No sunglasses are selected.

Original Gearbox character-art sample depicts short, muscular Salvador with blue mohawk, orange shirt, tattoos and bandoliers. The specific dualDahlpistols are declared selectable equipment, not exclusive fixed canon.
Selected original SeedsOfEvil cinematic image with Adon and Joshua is directly inspected locally. LaterRageWars/Turok3 designs and unverified facepaint are excluded.
